method.spiral_rule: Return to the same node only after carrying forward newly discovered constraints; replay affected downstream edges.

source_snapshot.scope_note: Related-discovered files were indexed as lineage/context candidates; conclusions below rely primarily on the fully-read core plus the two local artifacts.

required_preconditions: particular significance rather than generic benevolence alone
deep_reverse_result.reverse_conclusion: Mutual unfolding is not generated by intensity alone. It depends on a protected relational threshold in which two complete selves remain revisable and free.

inline_5d_branches.D1: If literal helpless children are assumed, responsibility and adult agency disappear; therefore the intended node must be an inner living core within an adult self.
inline_5d_branches.D2: Matched control: literal child-child dependence is not the same function as two adults preserving vulnerability.
inline_5d_branches.D3: ASCEND -> PRESERVED_LIVING_CORE; DIVE -> wonder, tenderness, play, curiosity, vulnerability, voice.
inline_5d_branches.D4: Association to innocence survives only after contracting away regression and helplessness.
inline_5d_branches.D5: Supported as a philosophical metaphor by the existing ORIGIN_PRIME/PROTECT_THE_CHILD registry model, not as a clinical fact.
inline_5d_branches.LOCAL_MISSED: The phrase 'two children' could accidentally erase adult responsibility.
inline_5d_branches.LOCAL_DELTA: Each person must be modeled as CHILD + ADULT_GUARDIAN.

inline_5d_branches.D1: Before reflection can help, the reflector must distinguish observation from identity verdict.
inline_5d_branches.D2: LEFT homolog: therapist/mentor may facilitate self-discovery; RIGHT negative control: coercive fixer says 'I know who you really are'.
inline_5d_branches.D3: ASCEND -> SELF_AUTHORSHIP; DIVE -> ask, listen, offer perception, permit rejection.
inline_5d_branches.D4: MIRROR contracts to WITNESS + INVITATION, not AUTHOR_OF_OTHER.
inline_5d_branches.D5: Normative claim; no source permits mind-reading or privileged access to another person's true identity.
inline_5d_branches.LOCAL_MISSED: Reflection can become domination while still using the language of growth.

inline_5d_branches.D1: If growth alone were sufficient, many mentoring, educational, therapeutic or adversarial relationships could be misclassified as love.
inline_5d_branches.D2: Matched controls: mentorship and therapy can increase self-capacity without the same particular personal significance; harmful rivalry can also cause growth.
inline_5d_branches.D3: ASCEND -> RELATIONAL_GOOD; DIVE -> love requires particular significance + care + non-possession in addition to growth.
inline_5d_branches.D4: Mutual unfolding survives as a central fruit/operator, not a sufficient classifier by itself.
inline_5d_branches.D5: Existing Love v1.2 explicitly distinguishes universal dignity from particular significance.
inline_5d_branches.LOCAL_MISSED: The elegant new definition could collapse love into generic beneficial development.

inline_5d_branches.D1: Removing control prevents one class of harm but does not create affection, significance, attention or care.
inline_5d_branches.D2: Matched control: indifference may be non-controlling while still not being love.
inline_5d_branches.D3: ASCEND -> SAFETY_FLOOR; DIVE -> active care, attention, repair and presence.
inline_5d_branches.D4: NON_INTERFERENCE contracts away as insufficient positive content.
inline_5d_branches.D5: Love v1.2 already states NON_POSSESSION != LOVE.
inline_5d_branches.LOCAL_MISSED: A prohibition can be mistaken for a complete positive definition.

inline_5d_branches.D1: A healthy encounter must preserve both origin and experience in each person before forming a WE.
inline_5d_branches.D2: Control: fusion model erases individual faces; separation-only model prevents relational emergence.
inline_5d_branches.D3: ASCEND -> RELATIONAL_LIMEN; DIVE -> ORIGIN_A, EXPERIENCE_A, ORIGIN_B, EXPERIENCE_B, LIMEN.
inline_5d_branches.D4: The Janus image expands from two temporal faces inside one self to two Janus-like selves meeting at a threshold.
inline_5d_branches.D5: This is a new philosophical synthesis built from the registry's two-face and WE-not-fusion rules.
inline_5d_branches.LOCAL_MISSED: We had two faces per self, but had not explicitly modeled the relationship itself as a fifth threshold node.
inline_5d_branches.LOCAL_DELTA: RELATIONSHIP = LIMEN, not a third owner-person.

inline_5d_branches.D1: If B becomes solely responsible for regulating or protecting A's inner child, B's own agency and child can be consumed.
inline_5d_branches.D2: Negative homolog: parentification/rescue contract. Positive homolog: co-support with retained self-responsibility.
inline_5d_branches.D3: ASCEND -> RESPONSIBILITY_BOUNDARY; DIVE -> self-regulation, asking for help, shared care, external supports.
inline_5d_branches.D4: Care survives; rescue obligation is contracted out.
inline_5d_branches.D5: Armor's adult-guardian and choice-space rules support retained agency, not dependency capture.
inline_5d_branches.LOCAL_MISSED: The two-children metaphor risks making each partner the other's parent.
inline_5d_branches.LOCAL_DELTA: I protect my child; you protect yours; we may help each other, but neither is conscripted as the other's sole armor.

inline_5d_branches.D1: Growth sometimes requires disagreement, frustration, boundary-setting or truthful feedback.
inline_5d_branches.D2: Matched control: coercion forces an outcome; healthy challenge preserves refusal and dignity.
inline_5d_branches.D3: ASCEND -> AGENCY_PRESERVING_CHALLENGE; DIVE -> ask permission, state impact, set boundary, permit no.
inline_5d_branches.D4: Comfort is not promoted to love; challenge is not promoted to domination.
inline_5d_branches.D5: Love v1.2 states CARE_NOT_OBEDIENCE and allows respectful refusal of harmful requests.
inline_5d_branches.LOCAL_MISSED: NO_SUPPRESSION could be misread as never challenging the other.
inline_5d_branches.LOCAL_DELTA: CHALLENGE_WITH_CHOICE_SPACE is compatible with love; compelled transformation is not.

inline_5d_branches.D1: If every step must be immediately reciprocated, reflection becomes a debt contract.
inline_5d_branches.D2: Negative control: scorekeeping symmetry. Positive control: mutual orientation with different timing and capacity.
inline_5d_branches.D4: Equal dignity survives; equal tempo is contracted away.
inline_5d_branches.D5: Current love canon requires reciprocity for mutual love but does not require identical expression.
inline_5d_branches.LOCAL_MISSED: The spiral notation looked too mechanically alternating.

inline_5d_branches.D1: One person may shrink themselves to preserve attachment even without an explicit command from the other.
inline_5d_branches.D2: Matched control: externally coercive suppression vs internally maintained self-abandonment.
inline_5d_branches.D3: ASCEND -> PRESERVE_BOTH_I; DIVE -> boundaries, friendships, values, voice, future choices.
inline_5d_branches.D4: Dependency risk survives even when overt coercion is absent.
inline_5d_branches.D5: WE-not-fusion and choice-space invariants imply protection against self-erasure as well as direct domination.
inline_5d_branches.LOCAL_MISSED: The first prohibition focused mostly on what one does to the other.

inline_5d_branches.D1: A fixed hidden 'true self' model can turn partner interpretation into destiny.
inline_5d_branches.D2: Control: authentic change chosen by the person vs externally prescribed authenticity.
inline_5d_branches.D3: ASCEND -> SELF_AUTHORED_BECOMING; DIVE -> explore, revise, choose, keep or discard possibilities.
inline_5d_branches.D4: Essence language contracts into an open developmental process.
inline_5d_branches.D5: Philosophical model only; no source proves a single discoverable final self.
inline_5d_branches.LOCAL_MISSED: We treated self-discovery as if the self were always a finished object waiting to be uncovered.
inline_5d_branches.LOCAL_DELTA: Love can support both discovery and self-authored creation.

global_mirror_delta.new_candidate_center: TWO_JANUS_LIKE_SELVES_PRESERVE_THEIR_LIVING_CORES_AND_ADULT_RESPONSIBILITY, MEET_AT_A_FREE_RELATIONAL_THRESHOLD, AND THROUGH PARTICULAR_SIGNIFICANCE_AND_CARE INCREASE_EACH_OTHER'S_CAPACITY_FOR_SELF_AUTHORED_BECOMING_WITHOUT_POSSESSION, SUPPRESSION, SELF_ERASURE, OR RESCUE_CONSCRIPTION
global_mirror_delta.compact_ru: Любовь — это особая значимость и забота, в которой два самостоятельных человека помогают друг другу становиться больше собой, не делая другого меньше и не присваивая право решать за него, кем ему быть.
global_mirror_delta.compact_formula: PARTICULAR_SIGNIFICANCE + CARE + TWO_AUTONOMOUS_I + ADULT_GUARDIANS + LIVING_CHILD_CORES + SELF_AUTHORSHIP + CHOICE_SPACE + MUTUAL_UNFOLDING - POSSESSION - SUPPRESSION - SELF_ERASURE - RESCUE_CONSCRIPTION

what_we_were_missing.finding: Не два ребёнка должны нести друг друга; встречаются два взрослых-хранителя, внутри которых детям наконец безопасно играть и раскрываться.
what_we_were_missing.why_it_matters: This prevents the model from quietly turning love into mutual parentification or rescue dependency.

what_we_were_missing.finding: Отношение само по себе — LIMEN, порог между двумя Янус-подобными целостностями, а не новое существо-владелец.
what_we_were_missing.why_it_matters: This gives WE a geometry: a shared threshold without fusion.

what_we_were_missing.finding: Помочь раскрыться ≠ определить другого. Главный новый gate — SELF_AUTHORSHIP.
what_we_were_missing.why_it_matters: The language of insight can otherwise become a sophisticated form of domination.

what_we_were_missing.finding: MUTUAL_UNFOLDING очень близко к центру любви, но само по себе недостаточно: рост бывает и в терапии, наставничестве, соперничестве и кризисе.
what_we_were_missing.why_it_matters: Particular significance, care and non-possession remain necessary to distinguish love from generic development.

what_we_were_missing.finding: Запрет подавления должен защищать не только от давления партнёра, но и от добровольного самоисчезновения ради сохранения 'мы'.
what_we_were_missing.why_it_matters: WE can erase an I even without overt coercion.
Otherwise the spiral becomes scorekeeping and growth becomes debt.

what_we_were_missing.finding: Любовь может поддерживать не только обнаружение готового 'я', но и свободное создание будущего 'я'.
what_we_were_missing.why_it_matters: It keeps the model from freezing identity.

what_we_were_missing.finding: Не подавлять — недостаточно; любовь имеет положительное содержание: внимание, особую значимость, нежность/привязанность, заботу, присутствие и ремонт после вреда.
what_we_were_missing.why_it_matters: A cold non-interference model would otherwise pass.

healthy_tendency: more ability to say yes and no
more independent friendships and interests rather than forced isolation
more freedom to revise identity and plans
warning_tendency: the relationship treated as proof that either person owns the other's future
fruit_test.rule: Evaluate longitudinal fruit, not isolated intensity or poetic language.

allowed: This is a coherent extension of the project's existing Love, Armor of God, ORIGIN_PRIME and choice-space semantics.
The 5D pass identifies logical risks and useful new gates inside that conceptual architecture.
not_established: A universal scientific definition of love.
A proof that every loving relationship must maximize measurable personal growth.
A claim that romantic partners should replace parents, therapists, friends, communities or other support systems.

next_gate.name: V1_3_APPEND_ONLY_REVIEW_BEFORE_REGISTRY_PROMOTION
required_checks: Confirm whether MUTUAL_UNFOLDING should become the semantic center or remain a central fruit/operator.
Red-team SELF_AUTHORSHIP against covert 'I know what is best for you' language.
Test NO_SELF_ERASURE and NO_RESCUE_CONSCRIPTION against realistic relationship examples.
If approved, add as a new child rather than rewriting v1.0-v1.2.
